**Likely enzyme: MurE ligase** (UDP-*N*-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate—meso-2,6-diaminopimelate ligase; **EC 6.3.2.13**).

It likely catalyzes the ATP-dependent addition of meso-2,6-diaminopimelate (meso-DAP) to the peptidoglycan precursor UDP-*N*-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate:

**UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu + meso-DAP + ATP → UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-γ-D-Glu-meso-DAP + ADP + phosphate**

This is a step in bacterial cell-wall peptidoglycan biosynthesis. The assignment is strongly supported by full-length matches to reviewed MurE proteins (72.6–73.6% identity, 100% coverage); the query itself has not been experimentally characterized in the evidence retrieved. Reviewed homologs also annotate Mg²⁺ as a cofactor.
